# Potburys

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Furniture and homeware shop from Sidmouth, Devon with an online store on Shopify. Sells sofas, armchairs, dining and bedroom furniture, beds, mattresses, lighting, carpets and flooring. Online delivery covers mainland UK and excludes Ireland, Northern Ireland and the islands.
